summary: A bright, game-like Spanish learning app where Aziz follows a winding path of bite-sized lessons, earns XP and crowns, keeps his streak alight and climbs a weekly league.

screens.name: Welcome to Charlo
screens.spec: Three playful slides with a bouncing mascot, Charlo the parrot. Slide 1 has a big 'Hola!' bubble and the line 'Learn Spanish in 5 minutes a day'. Slide 2 is 'I want to learn…', a grid of language cards with flag emojis, Spanish 🇪🇸 preselected with a thick green border. Slide 3 is 'Pick a daily goal', three chunky tiles: Casual 5 min, Regular 10 min (selected) and Serious 20 min. A full-width 'Let's go!' button leads to learning-path.

screens.name: Learn
screens.spec: A top bar shows the 🇪🇸 flag, a 🔥21 streak, 💎 gems and ❤️ hearts. Below it sits a colourful Unit 2 banner card, 'Food & Drinks', with a 'Guidebook' chip. A winding zig-zag path of round lesson nodes follows. Completed nodes are gold with crowns, the current node 'Ordering at a café' glows and pulses under a 'START' bubble, and locked nodes are grey, with a treasure chest midway and a Unit 3 header below. Tapping the glowing node opens lesson.

screens.name: Words
screens.spec: A gradient hero card reads '248 words learned' with a weekly +36 chip. Filter chips follow: All, Food, Greetings, Travel and Weak. A list of words follows, each with an emoji, the Spanish word, its English translation and a 4-bar strength meter coloured green, yellow or red. A sticky 'Practice weak words' button opens lesson.

screens.name: Gold League
screens.spec: The hero is a shiny gold shield badge with 'Gold League' and 'Ends in 3 days'. A ranked list of avatars with names and weekly XP follows, with the top 5 under a green 'Promotion zone' divider. Aziz's row is highlighted at #4 with 412 XP. The bottom 3 sit under a red 'Demotion zone' divider. Tapping Aziz's row opens profile.

screens.name: Profile
screens.spec: A big round avatar shows Aziz with 'Joined March 2026' and a 🇪🇸 flag. A 2×2 stat grid shows 🔥 21-day streak, ⚡ 1 840 total XP, 🏆 Gold league and 👑 14 crowns. An XP-this-week bar chart covers Mon–Sun. An 'Achievements' section lists badges with progress bars: Wildfire, Sage, Scholar and Champion. The 'View league' row opens leaderboard.

screens.name: Lesson
screens.spec: The top row has a close X, a thick green progress bar at 7 of 10 and ❤️ 4 hearts. The prompt 'Which one is "la manzana"?' sits beside a speaker button. A large photo card leads into a 2×2 grid of four answer tiles, each with an emoji and an English word, and the correct tile, apple, is selected with a blue outline. A bottom 'Check' button turns into a green 'Correct! ¡Muy bien!' sheet with 'Continue', which opens lesson-result.

screens.name: Lesson complete
screens.spec: Confetti bursts over Charlo cheering 'Lesson complete!'. Three stat cards follow: Total XP +15 in yellow, Accuracy 90% in green and Streak 🔥 22 days in orange. A streak flame banner reads 'You extended your streak!', and a small league line reads 'You moved up to #3 in Gold League'. The primary 'Continue' button returns to learning-path, and a secondary 'View league' button opens leaderboard.
